_comment: Facilitator answer key. 'must' threats are the ones a passing team cannot miss.

threats.text: Credential stuffing takes over customer accounts
Session or card data read in transit
HTTP flood exhausts the web tier
threats.mitigation: CDN/WAF rate limits, autoscaling, request size limits

threats.text: BOLA: user reads another user's order by changing the id
threats.mitigation: Object-level ownership check on every query
Bind variables / parameterised queries, input validation
Encryption at rest, private network, backup access control

threats.text: Forged OrderPlaced messages injected into the queue
threats.mitigation: Queue authN/authZ per producer, signed messages, schema validation in worker

threats.text: Worker trusts message content and runs with DBA-level grants
Forged payment webhook marks unpaid orders as paid
threats.mitigation: Verify webhook signature and timestamp, re-query provider

threats.text: Phished admin credentials used for refunds
threats.mitigation: Phishing-resistant MFA, device posture, step-up for refunds

threats.text: No record of who approved a refund
threats.mitigation: Audit event with actor, time, request id, written to append-only log

threats.text: Admin edits or deletes audit records
Something other than the web tier calls the API directly
threats.mitigation: mTLS or network policy between web and API

threats.text: Poison or flood messages stall fulfilment
threats.mitigation: Dead-letter queue, max size, consumer limits

threats.text: Unencrypted SQL traffic altered inside the network
threats.mitigation: TLS to the database, network segmentation
